description: The type declared before a method name that states what value the method gives back, or void for none.
Declaring several methods with the same name and different parameter lists, resolved by the compiler from the argument types.
The rule that every argument is copied into its parameter; for a reference the copy is the pointer, not the object.
The region of code, from a declaration to the end of its block, where a variable can be used.
A final parameter written Type... that accepts any number of arguments and is an array inside the method.
An early return at the top of a method that handles an unusual case so the main path stays flat.
